description: This file defines the immutable data object 'TellerTransactionData' used to represent transaction data within the Teller component of the Fineract system. It includes properties such as transaction ID, office ID, teller ID, cashier ID, client ID, transaction type, amount, and posting date, along with constructor and helper methods.

classes.name: TellerTransactionData
classes.description: An immutable data transfer object for teller transactions in the Fineract system, encapsulating transaction details such as IDs, type, amount, and posting date.

methods.description: Static factory method to create a new 'TellerTransactionData' instance with specified properties.
